Manx: tra va mee ching jelhein cha ren mee goll dys obbyr
va mee ayns y lhiabbee aym feiy'n laa gee charrey bob
jemayrt ren mee goll dys obbyr jemayrt
cha row ee feer vie cha laik lhiam gobbragh as ta mee foast red beg ching
jecrean ren mee goll dys y thie-fillym marish yn chuyr aym jecrean
ve feer trimshagh as ren mee keayney
jardain ren mee goll dys thie-bee peetsey marish yn charrey aym fastyr jerdein
v'eh yindyssagh ta mee laccal goll back reesht
jeheiney cha nel fys aym cre ren mee jeheiney ta mee red beg skee as cha nel mee cooinaghtyn
jesarn ren mee goll dys thie-bee oie jesarn
cha row eh feer vie cha laik lhiam gee ayns purt chiarn va mee ching as ren mee tilgey er y vraar aym
jedoonee cha ren mee monney jedoonee ta mee skee reesht as cha row mee laccal goll magh
ren mee cheet magh er y lhiabbee aym as skee
